science_vegetable: Magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear across the ferrofluid sea

horizon_goals.mid_term_milestone: Map the magnetic currents of the uncharted coast.
horizon_goals.campaign_arc_climax: Complete the Grand Map of the Enclave.

active_location.macro_silhouette: The jagged basalt cliffs plunge abruptly into an ink-dark sea that ripples with impossible geometric waves. Ribbons of bioluminescent kelp twist upward, caught in the invisible magnetic updrafts that scour the shore. Far out, towering pillars of liquid iron rise and collapse in silent, violent majesty, mapping the unseen architecture of the planet's magnetic field. This is the edge of the world, where the ocean breathes in sync with the sky's auroral fires.

sensory_palette.sight_and_color: Iridescent streaks of cobalt and violet dancing across a pitch-black fluid surface.
sensory_palette.sound: A deep, resonant thrumming that vibrates in the jawbone, undercutting the hiss of metallic surf.
sensory_palette.smell: Ozone and oxidized iron, sharp and metallic, like a lightning strike in a smithy.
sensory_palette.tactile_temperature: A numbing, static-charged chill that raises the hairs on the arms despite the physical exertion.

interactive_features.affordance_description: A tall rock formation vibrating with trapped kinetic energy.
A tidal pool where liquid iron surges in response to nearby movement.
Tangled fronds of glowing kelp that harden when subjected to sudden force.

reactive_toys.motivation_goal: To equalize the magnetic pressure differential across the boundary layer.
reactive_toys.consistent_method: Generates localized gravity anomalies and sharp bursts of static discharge.
reactive_toys.immediate_complication: Threatens to strip the protective coating off delicate mapping instruments.
reactive_toys.uninterrupted_escalation: The shear waves will compound, forming a localized magnetic maelstrom capable of physically dragging metallic objects into the sea.

three_levels_of_why.level_1_immediate: Kaio must stabilize his mapping sextant against the severe magnetic updrafts.
three_levels_of_why.level_2_local: Accurately charting the Kelvin-Helmholtz shear is essential to predict the next auroral storm.
three_levels_of_why.level_3_campaign_arc: Understanding the ferrofluid sea's mechanics is the key to unlocking the Enclave's long-term weather stability.

judge_tactician.failure_stakes_declared: If Kaio fails, the magnetic shear will scramble his mapping data and physically hurl his brass sextant into a surge pool, requiring a dangerous retrieval before the next storm hits.

graduated_outcomes.nat_1_false_intuition: Kaio misreads the shear pattern completely, accidentally tuning his instruments to amplify the magnetic interference, temporarily blinding his sensors.
graduated_outcomes.below_dc_complicated_fail_forward: He captures the data but loses his grip on the sextant, forcing a chaotic scramble to recover it as it skitters toward the ferrofluid edge.
graduated_outcomes.meets_dc_clean_success: Kaio perfectly anticipates the shear wave, locking in his measurements just as the magnetic pressure peaks.
graduated_outcomes.dc_plus_5_or_20_extended_lore: Not only does he secure the data, but Kaio also discovers a hidden resonant frequency in the shear wave that perfectly matches the ancient geothermal vents beneath the Enclave.

master_narrator.agency_handoff_prompt: As the final shear wave dissipates, Kaio tosses the glowing, static-charged data slate toward Ryn. 'Your turn to crunch the numbers before they bite!'
